# Missing Dependency Error Handling

The constructors for both AnthropicProvider and OpenAIProvider raise an LLMProviderError if the respective SDK is not installed. This could lead to unhandled exceptions if the user doesn't manage installation dependencies correctly.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/llm/provider.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.provider.AnthropicProvider.__init__`
- `knowledge_compiler/llm/provider.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.provider.OpenAIProvider.__init__`
